name: ST 404 Page Builder
author: Kristyna Bennett

sections.description:
Enhance your website’s 404 error page with ST 404 Page Builder, the easiest way to replace boring, default error pages with professionally designed 404 page templates. No coding required—simply install the plugin, select a pre-designed 404 template, and publish it instantly. A well-structured WordPress 404 page can improve user experience and keep visitors engaged instead of leaving your site.

Our custom 404 page templates are built for modern WordPress themes, ensuring fast performance and mobile responsiveness. Whether you run a blog, business website, or eCommerce store, you can choose from ready-to-use designs that match your site’s branding. Each template is optimized to reduce bounce rates and help users find their way back to important pages.

Setting up your custom 404 page takes just a few clicks. No need for complex configurations or manual coding—just pick a template, activate it, and you’re done! Start making lost pages work for you with ST 404 Page Builder today!

Looking for more ways to build and customize your WordPress website? Explore our complete WordPress Theme Bundle or browse our collection of Elementor WordPress Themes to find professionally designed themes for your next website project.

Key Features:
1. Pre-Built Templates
Choose from a wide variety of professionally designed 404 page templates to fit your website’s tone and style.
2. Fully Customizable (Coming Soon)
Adjust colors, fonts, images, and text to match your website branding with ease.
3. Responsive Design
Ensure your 404 pages look amazing on any device, including mobile, tablet, and desktop.
4. Analytics Integration (Coming Soon)
Track visitor behavior on your 404 page to understand traffic patterns and improve user experience.
5. Multilingual Support (Coming Soon)
Design custom 404 pages in multiple languages to cater to a global audience.
6. Redirect Options (Coming Soon)
Automatically suggest popular pages or redirect users to relevant sections of your website.
7. Lightweight & Fast
Optimized for performance, ensuring your website speed remains unaffected.

How It Works:

  1. Install the Plugin: Download and activate ST 404 Page Builder directly from the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Select a Template: Browse our collection of templates and choose one that suits your website’s theme.
  3. Activate: Save your changes and activate your new 404 page instantly.

Who Is It For?:

● Bloggers looking to keep readers engaged.
● Business owners who want a branded, professional touch.
● Agencies and developers managing multiple client websites.
● E-commerce stores aiming to reduce cart abandonment caused by navigation errors

Benefits:

● Retain Visitors: Turn lost visitors into leads or customers with helpful navigation and links.
● Boost Brand Image: A polished 404 page demonstrates professionalism and attention to detail.
● Improve Conversion Rates: Redirect traffic to high-performing pages or product categories.

Why ST 404 Page Builder Stands Out:

Unlike other 404 plugins, ST 404 Page Builder focuses on simplicity, performance, and creative freedom. Whether you want a sleek professional design or a fun, quirky 404 page, this plugin delivers the tools you need.

Notes

  • This plugin uses Bootstrap 4.6.0 for layout and responsiveness. It is included in the assets/css/bootstrap.min.css file.
  • Please make sure to check your theme for compatibility with Bootstrap styles.

Bootstrap Attribution

This plugin uses Bootstrap (v4.6.0), a popular open-source framework. For more information, visit: https://getbootstrap.com/
sections.faq:
Can I use ST 404 Page Builder with my existing theme?

Absolutely! Our plugin is compatible with all WordPress themes and adjusts seamlessly to your site’s design.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

Not at all! The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Can I add custom redirects to the 404 page?

Yes, you can easily configure redirects to guide users to relevant pages.

Is coding knowledge required?

No coding skills are needed! Our user-friendly interface makes customization a breeze.
